name: Weather Timeline Lite
description:
Weather Timeline Lite for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

Turn the unusually wide display into a readable 12 hour weather ribbon instead of another current weather card. See the temperature, condition and precipitation chance hour by hour, with a precise NOW marker and daylight versus darkness built directly into the timeline.

Sunrise and sunset appear where they actually happen in the forecast. Current conditions and the daily high and low stay visible at the side, and temperature units follow iCUE automatically unless you override them.

Forecasts are cached per widget instance. If a refresh fails, the last successful forecast stays on screen and is clearly marked stale instead of disappearing.

Choose from four polished themes and use any of the eight XENEON Edge slot compositions. Tap an hour for a focused temperature and precipitation view.

Weather access uses iCUE automatically when available. If your iCUE build does not provide weather access, you can paste your own free WeatherAPI.com key in settings as a local fallback.

Weather Timeline Lite is free. The optional Pro version expands the timeline and adds richer forecast detail without putting an ad inside the main weather ribbon.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial free release. 12 hour weather timeline, current conditions, hourly temperature and condition icons, precipitation probability, daily high and low, iCUE-aware units, selected location, sunrise and sunset markers, cached stale-data fallback, four themes, touch hour detail, and all eight XENEON Edge layouts.
